items.question: Do I need a referral to see a specialist?
items.answer: For Medicare rebates a GP referral is required for most specialists.

items.question: Is bulk-billing available?
items.answer: Bulk-billing is available for eligible concession card holders and children under 16.

items.question: Can I book a telehealth appointment?
items.answer: Yes — telephone and video consultations are available for existing patients.
